headline: Six Sectors Surge as Frontline Ownership Shifts Accelerate
war_summary: Three hours on the map still shows a largely static front, but the tempo of ownership changes has quickened across a half‑dozen theatres. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest sector, its 24‑hour event count rising to 64 with Colonial losses climbing 8,794 and Warden losses 14,382 while fresh enlistments reach 439. Fishermans Row follows with 33 flips, Colonial dead up 390 and Warden dead 530, enlistments 204. Callahans Passage holds at 29 events but casualties surge — Colonial +10,279, Warden +13,075 — and enlistments climb to 935. Stlican Shelf records 24 flips, Colonial +2,306, Warden +2,678, enlistments 247. Mooring County steadies at 14 events, Colonial +6,035, Warden +7,200, enlistments 667. Stema Landing adds nine flips, modest losses of 21 Colonial and 12 Warden, enlistments 61. Meanwhile, previously quiet Linn Mercy (3 events), Palantine Berm (7) and Nevish Line (5) have each logged their first ownership activity this cycle, signalling new pressure points. All other regions report no ownership changes.
